items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: Well, he was the bandmaster and he heard me play and asked me if I would take the orchestra.

ctx.x: Very, very, very famous trumpet. Well, he was the bandmaster and he heard me play and asked me if I would take the orchestra. And we left St. Louis with that outfit and went to New York, the old Madison Square Garden. And, uh, we rehearsed there for a couple of weeks before we went on the road. And then we went on the road and I stayed out with that outfit, oh, about two years. Then went back to New Orleans, stayed in New Orleans, and of course the old man got after me for about- but running around the country.…
I wondered what type of music you heard in the churches. Which church did you belong to? Were you Protestant or a Catholic?
